patches.policy: Prefer Xenon's Title Update pipeline. Do not duplicate the TU's guest-code reordering as a permanent Gracemeria patch.

enhancements.reason: Timing hooks are AC6-specific, but their ReXGlue implementation is coupled to ReXGlue timing/presentation.
Optional enhancement; current implementation reaches directly into the ReXGlue/Xenia renderer and guest memory.
Renderer-backend workaround/enhancement must be redesigned against Xenon's Xenos semantic layer, not copied.
Renderer-specific behavior must be verified against Xenon's canonical graphics path.
Xenon owns input; the ReXGlue virtual-pad layer is discarded. A future AC6 mapping preset can use Xenon Input API v1 without replacing input.
